build_coil100_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for COIL-100 with 7200 color images of 100 objects at 72 poses each
create_builder_info: create dataset info defining image features, angle labels, object IDs, and angle values for COIL-100
generate_coil100_examples: generate examples from COIL-100 PNG files by parsing filenames for object ID and angle labels
define_coil100_splits: define dataset splits by downloading and extracting the COIL-100 zip archive
review_builder_class: review the COIL-100 Builder class extending GeneratorBasedBuilder with version 2.0.0
